name: Docker Build and Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      dockerfile-path:
        description: 'Path to Dockerfile'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'build/docker/Dockerfile'
      context-path:
        description: 'Build context path'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '.'
      image-name:
        description: 'Docker image name'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'thawn/ttmp32gme'
      push-to-registry:
        description: 'Whether to push to registry'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      tags:
        description: 'Tags to apply to image'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        if: inputs.push-to-registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ inputs.image-name }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=${{ inputs.tags }}
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=sha

      - name: Build and test image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.context-path }}
          file: ${{ inputs.dockerfile-path }}
          target: test
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Build production image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.context-path }}
          file: ${{ inputs.dockerfile-path }}
          target: production
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          push: ${{ inputs.push-to-registry }}

      - name: Test production image
        run: |
          docker run --rm ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }} python -c "import sys; print('Production image works correctly')"
